sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》APP，首月免费。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》APP，获取30天免费访问权限。

sentences.en: During that week, it was just me being depressed.
sentences.zh: 那周里，我一直处于抑郁状态。

sentences.en: I only worked for like two days that week.
sentences.zh: 那周我只工作了两天左右。

sentences.en: Did your superiors notice your mood?
sentences.zh: 你的上级注意到你的情绪了吗？

sentences.en: They did.
sentences.zh: 注意到了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They would talk to me about it.
sentences.zh: 他们会找我谈话。

sentences.en: They'd come and talk.
sentences.zh: 他们会过来找我谈。

sentences.en: They'd have like other guys come and talk to me.
sentences.zh: 他们还会叫其他人来跟我谈。

sentences.en: You know, guys who'd live with me, who knew me very well.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是那些和我住在一起、非常了解我的人。

sentences.en: Can you just explain as best as you understand it?
sentences.zh: 你能尽可能按你的理解解释一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: What is happening to Huzaifa?
sentences.zh: 胡扎伊法发生了什么？

sentences.en: So he tells us that at this point, he's in his dorm room.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，当时他正待在宿舍里。

sentences.en: He's moping around, depressed, having a hard time recovering from what he just did.
sentences.zh: 他郁郁寡欢，情绪低落，难以从刚才做的事情中走出来。

sentences.en: And ISIS starts to parade a number of people in front of him.
sentences.zh: 然后ISIS开始在他面前游行展示一些人。

sentences.en: A commander comes in to tell him to buck up.
sentences.zh: 一位指挥官进来告诉他要振作起来。

sentences.en: And then a bunch of fighters that he knows and that I think he looked up to, who had become frontline fighters, come to see him.
sentences.zh: 接着，一群他认识的、我认为他很敬仰的战士，那些已经成为前线战士的人，来看望他。

sentences.en: Like, oh yeah, that's a good thing you did that.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，太棒了，你做得很好。

sentences.en: I wish I was in your position.
sentences.zh: 真希望我能处在你的位置。

sentences.en: You have such an honor to do that and everything.
sentences.zh: 能做那种事真是莫大的荣幸等等。

sentences.en: They tried to convince me that what I did was good.
sentences.zh: 他们试图说服我，说我做的是好事。

sentences.en: I'd be like, but the way I killed him, stabbing him in the heart, what kind of punishment is that?
sentences.zh: 我会说，但我杀他的方式，捅他的心脏，那算什么惩罚？

sentences.en: I've never heard of it.
sentences.zh: 我从没听说过这种事。

sentences.en: You know, they're like, no, for these guys, we have to put laws into our own land.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们会说，不，对于这些人，我们必须在自己的土地上实行法律。

sentences.en: And these guys have become so far from Islam.
sentences.zh: 而这些人已经背离伊斯兰教太远了。

sentences.en: After everything that we have learned about how ISIS operates, namely that we are not the lawgivers.
sentences.zh: 在我们了解了ISIS的运作方式之后，即我们不是立法者。

sentences.en: Allah is the ultimate lawgiver.
sentences.zh: 真主才是最终的立法者。

sentences.en: Tawheed al-Hakimiya?
sentences.zh: “认主独一的立法权”？

sentences.en: Tawheed al-Hakimiya, right?
sentences.zh: “认主独一的立法权”，对吧？

sentences.en: Tawheed al-Hakimiya.
sentences.zh: “认主独一的立法权”。

sentences.en: So the very concepts that brought him to this place are now being violated.
sentences.zh: 所以，当初带他来到这里的那些概念，现在却被违背了。

sentences.en: And the explanations that they're giving him aren't lining up.
sentences.zh: 他们给出的解释也根本对不上号。

sentences.en: It was becoming from increasingly like from a savior force coming in and, you know, guiding them, helping them live, putting good standards of life to something that's
sentences.zh: 它正逐渐从一个进来拯救他们、引导他们、帮助他们生活、建立良好生活标准的救世主力量，变成一种

sentences.en: trying to control them completely and telling them that they're the wrong type of MusliMs.
sentences.zh: 试图完全控制他们，并告诉他们是错误的穆斯林的东西。

sentences.en: You know, it became from some happy, like, I guess, happy place to an all of a sudden
sentences.zh: 你知道，它从一个快乐的，我想，快乐的地方，突然变成了一个

sentences.en: dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 独裁政权。

sentences.en: And I've seen this time and again, that that is what I saw with Jesse Morton, who was an al-Qaeda recruiter, how he pulled himself out.
sentences.zh: 我一次又一次地看到这种情况，我在杰西·莫顿身上也看到了，他曾是基地组织的招募人员，我看到了他是如何脱身的。

sentences.en: It's what Mubin Shaikh has said was his experience.
sentences.zh: 穆宾·谢赫也说过他有同样的经历。

sentences.en: He's a Canadian who tried to join the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 他是一个试图加入塔利班的加拿大人。

sentences.en: And defector after defector, I have seen this process.
sentences.zh: 一个又一个叛逃者，我都见证了这个过程。

sentences.en: And that is, I think, one of the most important takeaways.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是最重要的收获之一。

sentences.en: Because if we take the time to listen to these people, what we learn is that it is belief that brought them to this place, but it is also belief that brings them out.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我们花时间去倾听这些人，我们就会发现，是信仰把他们带到了这里，但也是信仰把他们带了出来。

sentences.en: It is the contradictions, the hypocrisy, and the moments in time when the Islamic State
sentences.zh: 正是那些矛盾、虚伪，以及伊斯兰国在某些时刻

sentences.en: does not live up to its theological message that finally propels people like Husayfa to leave.
sentences.zh: 无法履行其神学使命的时刻，最终促使像胡扎伊法这样的人选择离开。

sentences.en: But Munib, the Australian guy?
sentences.zh: 但是穆尼布，那个澳大利亚人呢？

sentences.en: So right, right as he's sitting with these doubts, he says his buddy Munib walks in.
sentences.zh: 就在他陷入这些怀疑的时候，他说他的伙伴穆尼布走了进来。

sentences.en: His name was Munib.
sentences.zh: 他叫穆尼布。

sentences.en: He was young like me too.
sentences.zh: 他也和我一样年轻。

sentences.en: Munib was in the same training course as him.
sentences.zh: 穆尼布和他参加了同一个训练课程。

sentences.en: I could tell he was not a guy who would tell on you or anything.
sentences.zh: 我看得出来他不是那种会告密的人。

sentences.en: He was a really chill guy, and I miss him so much right now.
sentences.zh: 他是个很随和的人，我现在非常想念他。

sentences.en: And he feels comfortable enough to share with him the doubts that he's feeling.
sentences.zh: 他觉得足够自在，可以和他分享自己心中的怀疑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so what did you tell him?
sentences.zh: 那你告诉他什么了？

sentences.en: I tell him all my doubts.
sentences.zh: 我告诉了他我所有的怀疑。

sentences.en: I'm like, you know, I don't feel comfortable with killing any of that.
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道，我对杀人这种事感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: I tell him about my family history and how I'm not that type of guy.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他我的家庭背景，以及我不是那种人。

sentences.en: You know, like if I die after doing something like this, how will I face God, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我做了这种事之后死了，我该怎么面对上帝，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And it's just making me feel really sick.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常恶心。

sentences.en: And he'd share that.
sentences.zh: 他也分享了他的想法。

sentences.en: He'd tell me about himself and everything.
sentences.zh: 他跟我说了他自己的事等等。

sentences.en: He's like how he has his doubts.
sentences.zh: 他说他也有自己的怀疑。

sentences.en: He was more of a guy like, yeah, but I really did leave everything behind so I can't go back.
sentences.zh: 他更像是那种，是的，但我确实抛弃了一切，所以我回不去了。

sentences.en: And he was the one who actually gave me the idea that you could possibly go back.
sentences.zh: 是他给了我其实可以回去的想法。

sentences.en: He said I can't go back because he had problems, but you realize that your family loves you.
sentences.zh: 他说他回不去是因为他有麻烦，但你意识到你的家人是爱你的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that I could that I could go back.
sentences.zh: 是的，我可以，我可以回去。

sentences.en: I have somewhere to go back to.
sentences.zh: 我有地方可以回去。

sentences.en: How common is this that somebody would escape from inside the caliphate?
sentences.zh: 有人从哈里发国境内逃出来这种情况常见吗？

sentences.en: So it's not it's not common.
sentences.zh: 这并不常见。

sentences.en: Obviously, when you go there, you know, you've you've left what they call.
sentences.zh: 显然，当你去那里时，你知道，你已经离开了他们所说的。

sentences.en: Oh, let me look this up.
sentences.zh: 哦，让我查一下。

sentences.en: One second.
sentences.zh: 等一下。

sentences.en: You've left what they call Dar al-Kufr, which means the land of of the infidels.
sentences.zh: 你离开了他们所说的“不信者的土地”。

sentences.en: And you've gone to Dar al-Islam, which is the land of Islam.
sentences.zh: 你去了“伊斯兰之地”，也就是伊斯兰的土地。

sentences.en: And you're supposed to be shutting one door.
sentences.zh: 你本应该关上一扇门。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not and not turning around and going back.
sentences.zh: 不能回头，不能回去。

sentences.en: But people did escape.
sentences.zh: 但确实有人逃了出来。

sentences.en: We know that quite literally.
sentences.zh: 我们很清楚这一点。

sentences.en: Thousands have escaped, right?
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人逃出来了，对吧？

sentences.en: Thousands of people.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人。

sentences.en: Thousands have escaped.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人逃出来了。

sentences.en: So as you're hearing him explain his particular escape story.
sentences.zh: 当你听到他解释他具体的逃亡故事时。

sentences.en: So I considered walking.
sentences.zh: 所以我考虑过步行。

sentences.en: It sounds like other stories I've heard.
sentences.zh: 听起来和我听过的其他故事一样。

sentences.en: But it's a desert.
sentences.zh: 但那是沙漠。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I packed up my stuff and getting out of ISIS controlled territory is not easy.
sentences.zh: 我收拾好东西，想要逃离ISIS控制的领土并不容易。

sentences.en: I had to steal a motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 我不得不偷了一辆摩托车。

sentences.en: And then from there, I just straight hauled it out.
sentences.zh: 然后从那里，我直接全速冲了出去。

sentences.en: You're trying to get past checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 你得设法通过检查站。

sentences.en: I knew which way to take and where they'd have their weakest checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 我知道该走哪条路，也知道他们哪里检查最薄弱。

sentences.en: Without being detected by ISIS.
sentences.zh: 且不被ISIS发现。

sentences.en: My heart was pounding at this point.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我的心怦怦直跳。

sentences.en: I was so scared.
sentences.zh: 我太害怕了。

sentences.en: They're subterfuge.
sentences.zh: 他们是在耍花招。

sentences.en: They stopped me.
sentences.zh: 他们拦住了我。

sentences.en: They're lying to people.
sentences.zh: 他们在欺骗人们。

sentences.en: I told them I'm just patrolling around the city.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们我只是在城里巡逻。

sentences.en: Hiding in the bushes.
sentences.zh: 躲在灌木丛里。

sentences.en: I take off my shirt and just lie flat on the ground.
sentences.zh: 我脱掉衬衫，平躺在地上。

sentences.en: That kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 就是那种情况。

sentences.en: And they're all, pretty much all of them, they're trying to get to Turkey.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎所有人，都在试图前往土耳其。

sentences.en: And I got a hold of these aid agencies, right?
sentences.zh: 我联系了那些援助机构，对吧？

sentences.en: Okay, that's the most logical border to go through because once you're in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是去往那里最合乎逻辑的边境，因为一旦你进入了土耳其。

sentences.en: The girl that I met, she was an American.
sentences.zh: 我遇到的那个女孩，她是美国人。

sentences.en: You're basically in an extension of Europe.
sentences.zh: 你基本上就等于是到了欧洲的延伸地带。

sentences.en: And she's the one who ultimately took me to the Turkish border.
sentences.zh: 最终是她带我去了土耳其边境。

sentences.en: So I went to Istanbul and I finally called my parents and they were livid.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了伊斯坦布尔，终于给父母打了电话，他们当时气疯了。

sentences.en: My mom just like, she just started crying.
sentences.zh: 我妈当时，她就开始哭。

sentences.en: She's like, oh, you're alive.
sentences.zh: 她说，噢，你还活着。

sentences.en: I thought you, you were dead.
sentences.zh: 我以为你，你已经死了。

sentences.en: I thought I'd lost my son, this and that.
sentences.zh: 我以为我失去了儿子，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: And there was just like a bunch of emotions.
sentences.zh: 当时真的充满了各种情绪。

sentences.en: It was really emotional.
sentences.zh: 那真的很感人。

sentences.en: I even started crying a lot.
sentences.zh: 我甚至也哭得很厉害。

sentences.en: I'm like, mom, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 我说，妈，对不起。

sentences.en: I, I couldn't do this anymore.
sentences.zh: 我，我再也做不下去了。

sentences.en: I couldn't take it.
sentences.zh: 我受不了了。

sentences.en: I was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我错了。

sentences.en: I should have listened to you and everything.
sentences.zh: 我本该听你们的话，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: It's just not right.
sentences.zh: 这根本不对。

sentences.en: I saw it for firsthand.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼见证了这一切。

sentences.en: Now what's it going to give me?
sentences.zh: 现在这又能给我带来什么呢？

sentences.en: They're not, they're the furthest thing away from Islam.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不是，他们离伊斯兰教最远了。

sentences.en: I'd rather, I'd rather follow what you guys were teaching me and everything.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿，我宁愿遵循你们教导我的那些东西。

sentences.en: You know, it was just an hour and a half, two hour call.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那通电话打了一个半到两个小时。

sentences.en: And then they're like, okay, so you're not, you can't come back to Canada.
sentences.zh: 然后他们说，好吧，所以你不能，你不能回到加拿大了。

sentences.en: You're going to be arrested because you have, there's no way to explain your disappearance.
sentences.zh: 你会因为你的失踪无法解释而被捕。

sentences.en: They're like, go to Pakistan and stay there.
sentences.zh: 他们说，去巴基斯坦待着吧。

sentences.en: So I stayed in Istanbul for a bit and finally booked my flight back to Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 所以我先在伊斯坦布尔待了一阵子，最后订了回巴基斯坦的机票。

sentences.en: Where my grandparents were already, they were waiting for me.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母已经在那里等我了。

sentences.en: They've, when I've met them, yeah, they, you know, my grandfather just didn't talk to me at all.
sentences.zh: 当我见到他们时，是的，他们，你知道，我祖父根本不跟我说话。

sentences.en: He didn't, he just ignored the fact that I was right there.
sentences.zh: 他没有，他直接无视了我就站在那儿的事实。

sentences.en: My grandmother was more worried about me and everything.
sentences.zh: 我祖母更担心我，诸如此类的。

sentences.en: She was crying and just hugging me.
sentences.zh: 她一直在哭，紧紧抱着我。

sentences.en: Um, so my parents actually booked me the ticket from here.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实是我父母从这儿帮我订的票。

sentences.en: They booked it from a travel agent here and they sent it to me on email.
sentences.zh: 他们通过这儿的旅行社订的，然后通过电子邮件发给了我。

sentences.en: Did you not worry about what would happen at immigration?
sentences.zh: 你难道不担心入境时会发生什么吗？

sentences.en: I was, I was, but I dressed in a way that didn't make me look suspicious.
sentences.zh: 我担心，我担心，但我穿得看起来不那么可疑。

sentences.en: And my, my beard was in a style, not like a full on beard.
sentences.zh: 而且我的，我的胡子留的是那种样式，不是那种大胡子。

sentences.en: There's two guards on each side of the gate.
sentences.zh: 大门口两边各有两个警卫。

sentences.en: And then they just like go through your password where you're, they ask where you're coming from.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就检查你的护照，问你从哪儿来。

sentences.en: And that's when I told them, okay, I came from Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 那时候我告诉他们，好吧，我从巴基斯坦来。

sentences.en: They're like, oh, okay, how long were you there?
sentences.zh: 他们说，噢，好吧，你在那儿待了多久？

sentences.en: 10 months.
sentences.zh: 10个月。

sentences.en: Why were you there for 10 months?
sentences.zh: 为什么在那儿待了10个月？

sentences.en: I told them university and everything.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们是去上大学之类的。

sentences.en: They're like, okay.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧。

sentences.en: And I said it in a way, I guess that it didn't make me seem like I was lying.
sentences.zh: 我说话的方式，我想，没让他们觉得我在撒谎。

sentences.en: And I was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 而且我说的也是实话。

sentences.en: I guess it was a sugar-coated version, but I was still telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 我想那是个美化过的版本，但我说的确实是实话。

sentences.en: Um, when I got back, I had to face the reprisals from my parents, obviously.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我回来时，显然不得不面对父母的责难。

sentences.en: But first tell me what happened at the airport.
sentences.zh: 但先告诉我机场发生了什么。

sentences.en: Ah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 啊，是的。

sentences.en: My mom and my sister picked me up and they just, you know, they, they hugged me and they started crying.
sentences.zh: 我妈和我妹妹来接我，她们，你知道，她们拥抱了我，开始哭泣。

sentences.en: They couldn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 她们简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: I was really skinny, like scratches on my face, a lot more scratches on my face.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很瘦，脸上还有抓痕，脸上的抓痕更多。

sentences.en: Um, you know, anytime I'd just drop dead soon, that's what I looked like.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，看起来就像随时会死掉一样，我当时看起来就是那样。

sentences.en: And then we went home and my mom, she wouldn't leave my side.
sentences.zh: 然后我们回家了，我妈，她寸步不离。

sentences.en: She just, she'd keep me in the kitchen with her while cooking dinner.
sentences.zh: 她做晚饭时都要让我待在厨房里陪她。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'd have to sleep on the ground of their room.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我得睡在她们房间的地板上。

sentences.en: Do you think that they've been able to forgive you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得她们能原谅你吗？

sentences.en: My mom, probably not.
sentences.zh: 我妈，可能不会。

sentences.en: I don't think my mom can ever forgive me for what I told her about killing and everything.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我妈能原谅我告诉她关于杀戮之类的事情。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Yeah, about what I've done.
sentences.zh: 是的，关于我做过的事。

sentences.en: She never expected that.
sentences.zh: 她从没预料到。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That I'd ever do something like that.
sentences.zh: 我会做出那样的事。

sentences.en: And my dad, probably not either.
sentences.zh: 我爸，可能也不会。

sentences.en: I've put them through a lot and it's time I make it up to them now.
sentences.zh: 我让他们受了很多苦，现在是时候补偿他们了。

sentences.en: And, and do you think that there's a chance you could go back to that ideology and to the, that life of violence?
sentences.zh: 那么，你觉得你还有可能回到那种意识形态和那种暴力生活中去吗？

sentences.en: No, no, I cannot at all.
sentences.zh: 不，不，我绝对不会。

sentences.en: I can't.
sentences.zh: 我不能。

sentences.en: No, it's, I've come too far from it.
sentences.zh: 不，我已经离它太远了。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's too much here that I have to give up now.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这里有太多东西是我现在必须放弃的。

sentences.en: Like I've, I've struggled so much to reintegrate myself.
sentences.zh: 就像我，我为了重新融入社会挣扎了太久。

sentences.en: So there's no point in throwing that out all over again and going back to that ideology.
sentences.zh: 所以没必要再把这一切抛弃，回到那种意识形态中去。

sentences.en: Something that's not right, it's not right.
sentences.zh: 那是不对的，那根本不对。

sentences.en: I mean, have you thought of turning yourself in as a way to kind of try to just, you know, break with it for good and not, and not?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你有没有想过自首，以此作为一种方式，你知道，彻底和过去决裂，而不是，而不是？

sentences.en: I don't think I could turn myself in because I, if turn it, I mean, it's scary what they do to me.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我能自首，因为如果我自首，我是说，他们会对我做什么很可怕。

sentences.en: I don't want to be in a prison.
sentences.zh: 我不想坐牢。

sentences.en: I don't want to be cut off again from the outside world.
sentences.zh: 我不想再次与外界隔绝。

sentences.en: Even no matter how much you're against it now, how much you hate it, you still did what you did.
sentences.zh: 即使你现在多么反对它，多么憎恨它，你毕竟还是做了你做过的事。

sentences.en: So it's, I'd have never thought of turning myself in.
sentences.zh: 所以，我从没想过要自首。

sentences.en: And I'd like, I would turn myself in not to the police, but to religious community leaders.
sentences.zh: 如果我要自首，我不会向警察自首，而是向宗教社区领袖自首。

sentences.en: I'd rather turn myself into and tell them what I've done.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿向他们自首，告诉他们我做过的事。

sentences.en: I think we've kept you long enough.
sentences.zh: 我想我们留你够久了。

sentences.en: I don't want you to get in trouble with mom.
sentences.zh: 我不想让你因为我而惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: She's definitely going to ask where I was, what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 她肯定会问我去了哪儿，在做什么。

sentences.en: I'll talk to you.
sentences.zh: 我会跟你联系的。

sentences.en: You can handle her now.
sentences.zh: 你现在能应付她了。

sentences.en: Have a good night.
sentences.zh: 晚安。

sentences.en: Relax and everything.
sentences.zh: 放松点之类的。

sentences.en: You know you're back, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道你回来了，对吧？

sentences.en: Let's hear it.
sentences.zh: 说来听听。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Have a safe trip.
sentences.zh: 一路平安。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: See you again.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: For the next few weeks, you'll be hearing Caliphate unfold on the daily every Saturday,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，你将会在《每日》节目中听到《哈里发》的进展，每周六更新，

sentences.en: with Chapter 6 coming next Saturday, May 26th.
sentences.zh: 第六章将于下周六，5月26日播出。

sentences.en: We're also releasing Caliphate as a standalone series, and we're publishing new episodes on Thursday afternoons, two days before you'll hear them on the daily.
sentences.zh: 我们还将把《哈里发》作为独立系列发布，我们会在周四下午发布新剧集，比你在《每日》节目中听到提前两天。

sentences.en: So if you want to listen early, you can subscribe to the series by searching for Caliphate on Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, or wherever you listen.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你想提前收听，可以在Apple Podcasts、Stitcher或你收听节目的任何地方搜索《哈里发》来订阅该系列。

sentences.en: And for Times subscribers, we're making episodes available a full week early.
sentences.zh: 对于《时报》的订阅者，我们提供提前整整一周的剧集收听权限。

sentences.en: So if you're a subscriber, Chapter 6 is available right now at nytimes.com slash caliphate.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是订阅者，第六章现在就可以在nytimes.com/caliphate上收听。

sentences.en: That's nytimes.com slash c-a-l-i-p-h-a-t-e.
sentences.zh: That's nytimes.com slash c-a-l-i-p-h-a-t-e.

sentences.en: If you've been looking for a reason to subscribe, now might be a good time.
sentences.zh: 如果你一直在寻找订阅的理由，现在可能是一个好时机。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我，莎拉·凯尼格，将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
